newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares mixed on lower turnover in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Shares mixed on lower turnover in Beirut.

text.p: Shares were mixed on reduced volume on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday and brokers said the market was cooling after a period of heavy activity.
Three shares rose, one fell, two were unchanged and there was no trade in three others.
Turnover fell 48 percent to 100,285 shares for a value of $996,485 from 192,557 shares worth $1,798,216 on Thursday.
"We have had a good activity in the market lately, I am not worried about this, I think we will have much more interesting activity in the next few weeks," a broker told Reuters.
Bank of Beirut regained some of the points it lost in the previous two days, rising to $3.9375 from $3.875 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce hit a new high of $18.50 from $18.25.
Banque Audi was unchanged at its all-time high of $23.125.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.99 percent to 154.91. The LISPI and the BLOM general indices rose 0.27 percent to 89.79 and 0.30 percent to 940.94 respectively.
Solidere A rose to $10.625 from $10.5 and B shares fell to $10.875 from $11.
Of the four industrial firms, Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.28125.
There was no trade in Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
